notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30213290/9e2197cee060a4a28811301bf2c8261b50904a34.png[/img]

You can now earn achievements for completing waves!
Miss the realistic bolt manipulation? Disable Auto Chamber in settings.

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*]Implemented Auto Chamber setting
[*]Improved item belt
[*]Improved UMP interaction
[*]Removed unfair spawn points on Europa
[*]Decreased early wave difficulty
[*]Implemented Wave Achievements
[*]Improved ammo drops
[*]Added upgrade station info in tutorial
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Weapons no longer collide with doors or lids
[*]Fixed attachment toggles
[*]Fixed large enemies getting stuck outside on Europa
[*]Improved Moon Occlusion
[*]Fixed shotgun pump issue
[*]Fixed camera freezing on death
[*]Fixed container lids getting stuck on Moon
[*]Fixed shotgun pump
[*]Fixed version in main menu
[/list]

[list]

[/list]

[h1]Optimizations[/h1]
[list]
[*]Optimized magazines by destroying them when empty
[*]Optimized rounds by destroying after delay
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.2.4.345
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30213290/7fa4593d325e1a806ceec7cf0427935665ea4198.png[/img]

Can you defeat this fiery new enemy? Get to Wave 8 to find out! It uses thrusters to charge towards you and once you're in range it will roast you with flamethrowers!

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]NEW[/b] Enemy
[*]Small drone will become more difficult at higher waves represented by color variations
[*]Added health indicator to belt
[*]Increased size of ammo belt UI
[*]Decreased small drone fire rate
[*]Increased small drone damage
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed enemies getting stuck on Moon
[*]Fixed enemies occasionally spawning underneath Moon Terrain
[/list]

[h1]Optimizations[/h1]
[list]
[*]Optimized projectiles
[*]Optimized melee weapon logic
[/list]

[i]Tip: All enemies have weak points![/i]
